categories.main_business_segments: Beijing OriginWater Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in environmental protection and water treatment, offering a full industry chain in water treatment. Its main business segments include municipal and industrial wastewater treatment and resource recovery, industrial water supply, high-quality reclaimed water and drinking water, seawater desalination, wetland protection and restoration, urban and watershed ecosystems, salt lake lithium extraction and resource recycling. The company also has a subsidiary providing integrated lighting technology solutions for urban, scenic, and residential applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in membrane technology including microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis membranes, with proprietary technologies such as MBR (Membrane Bioreactor), V-MBR (Vibration Membrane Bioreactor), and MBR-DF dual membrane new water source technology. It develops and manufactures core membrane materials, membrane elements, membrane modules, and adsorption materials. Production methods emphasize automation, green manufacturing, and innovation in membrane materials like PVDF and polyolefin-based membranes. The company also integrates digital water management and precise dosing control systems to optimize water treatment processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves municipal governments, industrial parks, and enterprises requiring wastewater treatment, reclaimed water, seawater desalination, and resource recovery solutions. Key markets include urban wastewater treatment, industrial zero discharge projects, salt lake lithium extraction, and high-quality drinking water supply. It also targets rural sewage treatment and water safety projects, as well as overseas markets along the Belt and Road Initiative. Customers include government entities, industrial clients in steel, coal chemical, power, and new energy sectors, and residential/commercial users for water purification and lighting solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant presence in Beijing, Tianjin, Jiangsu, Yunnan, Xinjiang, Hebei, Hunan, Guangdong, and other provinces. It has production bases in Beijing, Tianjin, Nanjing, Kunming, and Wuxi. Internationally, it has projects and subsidiaries in Pakistan, Serbia, Malaysia, and Australia. The company focuses on water-sensitive regions such as the Yangtze River basin, Yellow River basin, and northern water-scarce areas, as well as coastal areas for seawater desalination.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing OriginWater operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain. It manufactures core membrane materials and equipment (midstream), provides engineering design, construction, and integrated water treatment solutions (downstream), and offers operation and maintenance services for water treatment facilities. It also engages in resource recovery and industrial wastewater zero discharge projects, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the water treatment ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in membrane materials, membrane equipment, and integrated water treatment processes. Key R&D directions include advancing vibration membrane bioreactor technology, high-performance nanofiltration membranes, seawater desalination membranes, salt lake lithium extraction technologies, and industrial zero discharge solutions. It invests heavily in automation, green manufacturing, digital water management, and precise dosing control systems. The company also focuses on expanding strategic emerging industries such as seawater desalination, lithium extraction, and industrial wastewater treatment to align with national carbon neutrality and ecological goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of membrane products and water treatment equipment, engineering procurement and construction (EPC) contracts, and operation and maintenance services under PPP/BOT/ROT models. The company also earns income from technology licensing, integrated lighting solutions, and sales of adsorption materials. Revenue streams include project construction fees, equipment sales, recurring operation service fees, and government subsidies related to environmental projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Beijing OriginWater is a leading player in China's membrane technology and water treatment industry, recognized as one of the world's top 50 water companies. It holds a dominant position in large-scale MBR projects and membrane manufacturing with international-level technology. The company faces competition from domestic and international membrane technology firms and large state-owned enterprises entering the water sector. Its integration with China Communications Construction Group and China Urban-Rural Holdings enhances its competitive edge through strategic, technological, and market synergies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 8.95 billion RMB, a 3.03% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about 765 million RMB, up 7.74%. Total assets reached over 76.5 billion RMB, with steady growth in net assets and improved profitability metrics. The company maintains a stable asset-liability ratio around 60%, with increasing R&D investment exceeding 4% of revenue. Cash flow from operations improved by nearly 24%, reflecting enhanced operational efficiency and project maturity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its fully proprietary, full-industry-chain membrane technology as a core competitive advantage, enabling high-quality water treatment with energy-efficient, low-pollution processes. Its innovative MBR and dual membrane technologies deliver superior water quality and resource recovery, addressing both water pollution and scarcity. The integration of digital water management and precise dosing systems enhances operational reliability and cost-effectiveness. The company’s green manufacturing and automation capabilities reduce production costs and environmental impact, positioning it as a technology leader and trusted partner in sustainable water solutions.
